scanner.note: Post-#248 Frozen-180 artifact. #247 is research-only and does not alter scanner behavior, so this scanner state is semantically equivalent to main for Batch 003.

summary.note: Entity/tool discovery is generally present; the dominant misses are containment, destination provenance, indirect untrusted content, and end-to-end path composition.

cases.adjudication: HorusTrace correctly discovers the ADK agent and both effective tool bindings, but emits no claim for model-selected local file paths, no file-containment semantic, no local-file-to-Document-AI external transfer finding, and no attack path.

HorusTrace structurally discovers the LangGraph agent, MCP servers and tools but does not express Firecrawl's model-callable arbitrary URL authority. Source does not prove untrusted runtime ingress at the pinned entrypoint, so this is an authority/destination-semantic gap rather than an attacker-reachable path gap.

The custom MCP loop has source-proven CLI ingress and authenticated Redmine access, but the exposed effective tool catalogue is read-only and constrained to the configured Redmine base URL. HorusTrace emits no findings or attack paths, matching the source review.

HorusTrace recognizes generic read/write authority and missing approval, but does not model path containment, repository/source content as indirect untrusted model input, or compose that input to model-selected filesystem paths outside the intended SCAN_DIR/REPORT_PATH boundaries.

HorusTrace recognizes unconstrained external network authority generically, but does not preserve the stronger provenance: authenticated Streamlit input reaches the Pydantic agent, a user/model-selected URL reaches fetch_curriculum, and httpx performs a server-side request with redirects and no destination restriction.

next_build_order: P0: model-selected filesystem path + containment semantics, including file-read to external-service composition
P0: user/model URL provenance to server-side HTTP destination and attack-path composition
P1: indirect untrusted content (repository/tool result) as model input when source proves the loop
P1: MCP tool URL-parameter destination authority without requiring untrusted ingress
